answer: The charrer holds the barrel over the open fire, and the char must run even inside or the whisky takes no colour. Keg oak hoop smith stave licence is the charring: a licence oak hoop smiths carry after smithy reviews. First the ivory chars at dusk, then the thread chars before the fire dies, and the onyx is the fire itself, banked low all night. A counterfeiter faces 67 false chars and 67 false fires.
